Initial commit

Add editorial block context and guide title support
Add optional block editorial metadata schema and validation.
fix(comments): make deep links robust across paginated threads
Add inline comment edit/delete ownership UX
Add live activity surfaces to the homepage

Add block metadata to block view

feat(notifications): add header inbox UI for comment notifications
feat(comments): add report action to block view comments
feat(comments): add authenticated comment composer to block view
feat(comments): add block-view comment sort toggle
feat(comments): link comment authors to profiles when user exists
feat(block-view): add SSR comments section with load-more pagination
feat(notifications): add comment notifications with email and unread tracking
feat(comments): add reporting with auto-hide threshold
feat(comments): add create endpoint with DB-backed rate limiting
feat(comments): add read-only comments model and fetch on block view

Roll out Draft badge to all block title views (#293)

* feat(ui): roll out Draft badge to all block title views

- Extract draft badge into reusable _draft_badge partial
- Render badge anywhere block.status === 'in-progress'
- Add blockCommon i18n namespace to affected routes
- Add block-common.css to templates that render block titles
- Standardize title markup using .title-row container
- Update room dashboard tab logic for in-progress blocks

This ensures consistent visual indication of draft state
across home, archive, tags, room dashboards, and block view pages.

* lint(_draft_badge): add newline to end of file

feat(blocks): show Draft badge for in-progress blocks; rename unfinished -> titleOnly

- Use status === "in-progress" for Draft/Borrador badge on home
- Rename unfinishedMeta/isUnfinished to titleOnlyMeta/isTitleOnly
- Include status in block preview DTO for templates and filtering
feat(blocks): show Draft badge for unfinished blocks
feat(ui): adaptive rendering for empty block content (remove placeholder HTML)
fix(blocks): remove UTC midnight lock and extend inactivity timeout to 7d

chore: upgrade to Node 24, migrate to esbuild, and modernize Google Drive auth

- Bump Node engine to ^24
- Upgrade key dependencies (googleapis, jsdom, mongodb, mongoose, jasmine, etc.)
- Replace Babel + Browserify pipeline with esbuild
- Migrate Google service account auth to GoogleAuth().getClient()
- Normalize private_key newlines for env-based credentials
- Remove unused analyzeBPM module and legacy audio route
- Simplify build and postinstall scripts

Resolves 403 "unregistered callers" error from Drive API after googleapis upgrade.

chore: Remove manual whatwg-url and fast-xml-parser overrides

Upstream packages have now been patched
Add reaction count pills to tag results list
feat(room dashboard): add reaction-count pills to block list items
Hydrate reaction counts on archive date page
Add reaction count pills to best-of archive
feat(best-of): add reaction count pills to room best-of lists
fix(home): prevent zero-count flash before reaction hydration
feat(home): show reaction count pills via batch hydrate (i18n + ARIA)
feat(reactions): add reaction bar to block view with login modal prompt
Add reactions API + BlockReaction model (v1)
Decrease max width to display login button in toolbar
feat(ui): add quick search button to sticky header
Remove home link from navigation links toolbar (logo provides homepage link)

Add room dashboard "Explore" chips including in-room search

- Add Explore label + chip links on room dashboard (all blocks, by date, best of, search)
- Add i18n strings for EN/ES
- Style Explore section as pill chips for cleaner layout

Add public search page with pagination and i18n
- Adds /search page for public block search
- Adds pagination via shared _pagination mixin
- Adds Search link to global nav (EN/ES)
- Adds i18n bundles for search (EN/ES) and search page styling

feat(search): add v1 search API with MongoDB text index

- Add /api/v1/search endpoint with q/roomId/lang/skip/limit
- Implement $text search with relevance scoring and groupId dedupe
- Prefer requested content language when available
- Add blocks text index over title/content/tags/description
Clear ui_requested cookie after fallback redirect to prevent sticky banner
Fix header z-index layering for drawer, backdrop, and language switcher
Fix: header height constant whether banner shows or not.
Fix z-index ordering to ensure clickability of ui lang selector and visibility of menu when in backdrop mode.

Add UI language fallback banner for untranslated locales
- Distinguish selectable UI locales from translated UI locales
- When an untranslated /{lang} prefix is requested, redirect to default UI lang
  while remembering the requested locale via a short-lived cookie
- Show a dismissible banner indicating the requested locale isn’t translated yet
- Harden locale selection defaults (SUPPORTED_UI_LANGS / DEFAULT_UI_LANG)
- Tweak header/menu z-index layering so banner + menus stack predictably

Revamp navbar: sticky full-bleed header, responsive layout, mobile auth links

- Add Dashboard nav label (EN/ES)
- Make header sticky + full-bleed with inner margin wrapper
- Improve navbar flex behavior and mid-width horizontal scroll
- Add mobile-only Dashboard/Login/Logout entries with breakpoint rules
- Wire mobile Logout to same logout handler in auth.js
- Add brand mark image next to site name in header

fix(deps): override fast-xml-parser to patched version

Adds npm overrides to force fast-xml-parser >=5.3.4 (DoS fix) while AWS SDK transitively pins 5.2.5.
update caniuse Node module
Adjust padding to better align hamburger menu and language switcher

feat(i18n,ui): add UI + block language switchers with flags and responsive block header

- Add global UI language switcher in navbar (flag-icon-css + uiPathFor helper)
- Add block translation switcher on block view with “Translations” label + availability hint
- Improve block view header layout and mobile action button wrapping
- Make long language menus scrollable + add details autoclose behavior
- Footer: prevent awkward wrapping; stack on ultra-narrow screens
- Remove legacy lang-switcher CSS
chore(i18n): finish uiPath cleanup for remaining internal links

Add UI-prefixed routing for room home pages and update internal links

- Onboard /rooms/:id to UI language prefix redirect rollout
- Update internal room links to use uiPath() consistently
- Keep block routes unprefixed and adjust controller redirects accordingly
- Fix pagination and template edge cases discovered during rollout

Onboard /users/:username/blocks to UI-prefixed routing

Add user block list routes to localized path rollout and update internal
links to emit canonical UI-prefixed URLs. Block detail URLs remain
unprefixed by design to allow content-language independence from UI
language.

Add /dashboard/blocks to UI prefix rollout and update internal links

Includes /dashboard/blocks in localized path redirects and ensures
internal navigation, sorting, and pagination emit UI-prefixed URLs.
Add UI-prefixed support for /dashboard/starred-rooms
Add /dashboard/stats to UI language prefix rollout
Localize dashboard links and redirects
Localize user profile links and URL-encode usernames

localize forgot-password route and links
Add uiLang-prefixed verify-email links and include /verify-email in localized route rollout

Add UI-prefix support for tag detail pages and update tag/user/room links
Roll out UI-prefixed /login links
Fix missing backticks in create-block localized link
Enable UI-language prefixed routing for block creation page
Roll out ui-prefixed paths for room archive + index
Fix UI-prefixed links on archive date pages
Enable UI-prefixed archive day routes
Enable UI-prefixed archive month routes
Remove hardcoded background from table scroll wrapper
Localize room request form feedback messages
Enable language-prefixed paths for /support and /random
Roll out language-prefixed paths for /about
Enable language-prefixed paths for best-of archive routes
Roll out language-prefixed paths for /archive
Enable UI language prefixes for /tags route and links

Perf-gate homepage timings; harden cache TTL + stampede control; warm homepage caches
- Gate homepage perf timing behind PERF_HOME so normal requests avoid instrumentation overhead
- Extend cache.get to accept { ttlMs, jitterMs } while preserving numeric TTL compatibility
- Add in-flight promise de-duping to prevent cache stampedes on misses
- Introduce per-function TTLs for heavy homepage getters (top blocks, trending tags, etc.)
- Warm homepage caches via cron (every 2 minutes + shortly after startup) for en/es

Roll out UI language prefixes for /rooms
- Add /rooms to localized path rollout
- Update templates to link to rooms directory via uiPath('/rooms')

Roll out UI language prefixes for /privacy
- Add /privacy to localized path rollout
- Update footer link to use uiPath('/privacy')

Add UI language path prefixes with homepage-only rollout
- Parse optional /:ui prefix, set uiLang + cookie, and
  internally strip prefix for routing
- Add gated 302 redirect from / to /{ui} based on cookie
  /query/Accept-Language
- Canonical + hreflang now prefer prefixed URLs only for
  localized rollout paths
- Layout renders hreflang alternates when provided
